svg.title: CANUF: constraint-aware neurosymbolic uncertainty quantification
svg.desc: Constraints are mined from scientific literature into a knowledge graph and verified; a Bayesian neural backbone gives a predictive distribution; a differentiable constraint layer projects samples that violate physics back onto the feasible set and widens uncertainty for large corrections. Expected calibration error falls 34.7% versus Bayesian neural networks with 99.2% constraint satisfaction.
svg.text: CANUF · calibrated uncertainty that obeys scientific constraints
